5. [LGRA.16.5] **Per-schema TTL value.**
   A `ttl` schema's `schema_lifecycle` ([LGRA.5.1]) is
   `scope ttl` and a `time_expr`, written after the schema
   NAME per [LGRA.5.2]. The duration is mandatory at the source
   level: a `ttl` schema whose source omits it does not
   parse, and no integrator config supplies a default.
   A per-emit override is available via
   `emit X retain: <DUR>` per [LDTL.4.1].
